name: How long does it take to repair a water-damaged ceiling?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to repair a water-damaged ceiling?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for repairing a water-damaged ceiling depends on the severity of the leak and the extent of the damage. Minor repairs, like patching and painting, might take a few days. However, if water penetration is extensive, requiring water extraction, structural drying, mold remediation, and drywall replacement, the process can take several days to a few weeks. The drying phase itself can take 3-5 days. Our team aims to work efficiently to restore your property quickly and effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies from a few days for minor issues to several weeks for extensive damage, including drying and remediation. The drying process alone takes 3-5 days.
